headline: Lithium surge lifts profit sharply, guidance raised
summary_short: Albemarle's Q2 FY2026 net sales rose 31.1% y/y to $1.74 billion and diluted EPS hit $3.52, as net income surged to $480 million on higher Energy Storage and Specialties pricing. Management raised its full-year Specialties outlook and cut 2026 capex guidance to about $500 million.
summary_long: Net sales grew 31% y/y to $1.74 billion, led by Energy Storage (+78%) on lithium pricing +73% and volume +11%, and Specialties (+21%) on price +11% and volume +8%. Adjusted EBITDA rose 155% to $858 million; Energy Storage adjusted EBITDA rose 229% and Specialties 61%, both on pricing/volume plus ongoing cost and productivity actions ($100M of run-rate savings YTD, tracking to the high end of the $100-150M FY target). Net income of $480 million reversed a near-breakeven year-ago quarter. Free cash flow was $638 million on 83% operating cash flow conversion. Total debt fell to $1.9 billion (net debt/EBITDA ~0.5x). Management raised full-year Specialties outlook (net sales $1.4-1.6B, EBITDA $275-325M) and cut 2026 capex guidance to ~$500 million.
